warning element_invalid_self_closing_tag 5:1-5:24 Self-closing HTML tags for non-void elements are ambiguous — use `<textarea ...></textarea>` rather than `<textarea ... />`
    https://svelte.dev/e/element_invalid_self_closing_tag
warning non_reactive_update 2:6-2:11 `value` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
    https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
